structure.unit: Comprehensive Community Corrections Act for Local-Responsible Offenders

law.catch_line: Board to prescribe standards; biennial plan
law.text: The Board shall approve standards as prescribed by the Department for the development, implementation, operation, and evaluation of local community-based probation services and facilities authorized by this article, which shall include standards for the transfer of supervision between local community-based probation agencies. Any city, county, or combination thereof which establishes and provides local community-based probation services pursuant to this article shall submit a biennial criminal justice plan to the Department for review and approval.
